heroHeadline: Madrid Residency Rest Day — 128,000 Fans Across Two Nights; Night 3 on June 2
heroSubtitle: June 1 is the first rest day of Bad Bunny's landmark 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid, scheduled between Night 2 (May 31) and Night 3 (June 2). The first two sold-out nights combined drew more than 128,000 fans — on pace toward the 640,000 projected across all 10 shows (May 30–June 15), the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history. Night 1 featured the first-ever live performance between Bad Bunny and Myke Towers, joining for 'Adivino' and a medley of shared tracks. 'DtMF' holds at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs for its 61st consecutive week (chart dated May 30, 2026) — the all-time record. Spotify monthly listeners remain at 114.1M on tour momentum. After Madrid, the DtMF World Tour plays Düsseldorf (June 20–21), Arnhem (June 23–24), London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (June 27–28 — first UK stadium dates), and closes in Brussels on July 22.
